text: My daily routine is simple, but I follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and drink a glass of water. After a quick breakfast, I start work at nine and check my emails. I take a short lunch break around noon. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or cycling. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read a book before bed. Staying consistent helps me feel organised, healthy, and ready for the next day.
